suggestions.title: Show the known catalog total in the Paperwhite source header
suggestions.observation: All three candidate source headers show only language and version. The original source reference includes a total, and the actual final states provide catalog_count=128 and catalog_result_count=128.
suggestions.expected: Retain the compact source metadata line and append the real known catalog total. Use truthful loaded/unknown wording only when the provider count is actually unavailable.
suggestions.recommendation: Render the available catalog count in the shared Paperwhite source-header metadata line without moving the header, tabs, or five-row catalog allocation.

declaration_evidence.detail: Line 53 renders language, version and totalLabel in the same 13-pixel metadata line.
The Paperwhite source header explicitly includes language, version and total count.

suggestions.data_exception_check: The actual value may differ from 128. The omission of an available value is not a data-value exemption.

suggestions.title: Keep wrapped filter tags content-sized on the final row
suggestions.observation: Seven first-row tags are compact, while the two final tags expand to about 283 logical pixels each. The original reference keeps compact tag widths on every row.
suggestions.expected: The real tag vocabulary may wrap differently, but the incomplete final row must retain each tag's intrinsic label width plus horizontal padding instead of sharing the full row width.
suggestions.recommendation: Remove per-row fill/growth from the Paperwhite tag controls; measure each real label with the reference padding and preserve stable compact widths across wrapped rows and pages.

declaration_evidence.detail: The tag container uses flex-wrap with an 8-pixel gap. Tag buttons use height 42 pixels and padding 0 16 pixels; no flex-grow is declared.
Tags are individual tri-state filter controls in the source filter sheet.

suggestions.data_exception_check: Nine actual tags instead of twelve sample tags is allowed. Expanding only the incomplete last row changes control geometry and visual weight.

suggestions.title: Preserve a content-sized endpoint callout in the Add Source sheet
suggestions.observation: The candidate endpoint callout spans about 386 x 62 logical pixels at x=210..596, y=567..629. The matching original reference has a compact approximately 184 x 40 callout at x=210..394, y=589..629 after reference-scale normalization.
suggestions.expected: Keep the actual endpoint, QR and required pairing code, while retaining a content-sized dashed URL callout and deliberate spacing within the QR information row.
suggestions.recommendation: Size the dashed URL frame to its actual text plus the reference padding instead of stretching it across the remaining row; place the real pairing code and waiting status in the adjacent text stack without enlarging that callout.

declaration_evidence.detail: The text stack uses an 8-pixel gap. The URL span explicitly uses align-self:flex-start, 19-pixel text and 5px 12px padding.
The source sheet groups QR, browser-opening label, actual local address and waiting state above the direct-entry row.

suggestions.data_exception_check: The actual endpoint and code are permitted truthfulness differences. The stretched dashed callout is a separate geometry difference.

suggestions.title: Tie the filter trigger's inverted state to applied filters
suggestions.observation: The open filter case displays a black 48 x 48 trigger with a white filter icon, while catalog_active_filter_count=0 and all nine tag states are neutral. The matching original reference keeps the trigger white with a black icon in this open, unapplied state.
suggestions.expected: Opening the sheet alone keeps the neutral trigger appearance. Inversion represents applied filters, as declared by the frozen prototype.
suggestions.recommendation: Drive the trigger fill from applied-filter state, preserving any transient press feedback separately from the captured open-sheet state.

declaration_evidence.detail: filterBg and filterStroke depend on s.applied > 0. openFilter only sets sheet='filter'.

suggestions.data_exception_check: No actual filter is applied in this state. Different provider data does not explain the inverted applied-state affordance.

unresolved_evidence_gaps.detail: The assigned frozen input leaves capture_helper_hashes as 'Pending final full manifest reconciliation'. The coordinator has identified this as declared incremental-stage final-manifest work. This review preserves the pending value and does not turn it into a product suggestion.
unresolved_evidence_gaps.required_resolution: Coordinator reconciliation with the canonical final helper manifest and freeze tuple.

limitations: This is an 11-case batch review and does not establish a complete or clean round.
No historical finding is closed by this report. Independent regression review is separate.
The actual final states are demo/offline; no live provider success, endpoint reachability, real HTTP search, installation/update completion, or retry result is claimed.
Blank composition states do not qualify active Pinyin composition, candidate rendering, candidate selection, or composition preservation across keyboard modes.

Static desktop PNGs do not qualify physical e-ink waveforms, natural light, touch feedback timing, evdev/rotation mapping, sleep/wake, performance, hardware capability effects, or independent live cache leases.

Manual logical-region coordinates in findings are visual approximations from originals, not image-processing measurements. No needed original crop remains unresolved for the visible foreground UI in this batch.
